name: BetaBot String Maker
description: A Telegram bot to generate Pyrogram & Telethon string sessions easily.

OWNER_ID.description: ʏᴏᴜʀ ᴛᴇʟᴇɢʀᴀᴍ ɴᴜᴍᴇʀɪᴄ ᴜsᴇʀ ɪᴅ (ᴀs ᴏᴡɴᴇʀ)

MONGO_DB_URI.description: ʏᴏᴜʀ ᴍᴏɴɢᴏ-ᴅʙ ᴜʀɪ sᴛʀɪɴɢ (sᴛᴀʀᴛɪɴɢ ᴡɪᴛʜ mongodb+srv...)

MUST_JOIN.description: Channel or group username for force-join (without @)

START_IMG.description: Link to an image shown in /start (jpg or png)

MY_2FA_PASSWORD.description: Your own Telegram 2FA (two-step verification) password, auto-filled during session generation so you don't have to type it. Leave empty to always be asked manually.

LOG_CHANNEL.description: Telegram channel/group ID where the bot sends its logs (startup, stop, every generated session). The bot must be a member/admin of this chat.
